create_Selector_from_csv: create a Selector DataFrame by reading a CSV file using the read_csv class method
select_rows_by_column: select rows from a Selector DataFrame where a column matches a value or list of values
select_and_drop_columns: select rows by column criteria and drop the selection columns from the resulting Selector
get_unique_values: get the set of unique values for a single column or unique tuples across multiple columns
assert_equivalent_dataframes: assert two Selector DataFrames are equivalent up to row and column permutations
